entities.summary: Toby Aaron Hamilton, known professionally as 6arelyhuman, is an American singer, rapper and songwriter. In 2022, they released the single "Hands Up!" and "XOXO ", which became viral hits on TikTok and led to their signing with Artist Partner Group.
